done_when: This repo's forge.toml sets workers = "claude" and [models.build], [models.fix] and [models.lite] to claude-opus-5-5 at medium effort without subagents; review stays on Codex; forge doctor passes

findings.body: The test at tests/test_codex_config.py:15-22 runs in the configured `pytest tests` suite and still asserts `workers == "codex"`, `gpt-6-sol`, and Luna subagents. It fails against this config. Update it to verify the requested Claude settings and unchanged Codex review setting.
findings.title: Not done: the repository worker-model config test

findings.body: tests/test_fix_first_codex_round_luna_helpers.py:34-53 copies this repository's `forge.toml`, invokes `forge work`, then expects a Codex `thread/start`. With `workers = "claude"`, src/forge/worker.py:66 and :73 route that first fix round to Claude using `[models.lite]`, so the expected Codex call cannot occur; the test also supplies no Claude stub. Give the old Codex contract an explicit Codex fixture or adapt this test to check the new Claude route.
findings.title: Not done: the first-fix worker integration test

findings.body: src/forge/ask.py:25-30 still starts a Codex conversation, and src/forge/codex.py:137-138 takes its default model from `[models.lite]`. This setting therefore sends `claude-opus-5-5` to Codex on an ordinary `forge ask` call. Codex's [config reference](https://developers.openai.com/ja-JP/docs/config-file/config-reference) specifies OpenAI as the default model provider, so the command cannot use that Anthropic model without a separate provider setup. Give `ask` a Codex-compatible default or route it through Claude.
findings.title: Keep `forge ask` from sending the Claude lite model to Codex

why: The owner moved this repo's workers from Codex to Claude on Opus 5.5 at medium effort, keeping Autoreview on Codex
